critical_variable: (none — primitive delay call, no resource lifecycle)
path_conditions: called from non-atomic context (PM resume callback, never holds spinlock/IRQ)
bug_type: busy-wait-in-sleepable-context (mdelay used where msleep would do)
cwe: CWE-1050 (Excessive Platform Resource Consumption / Inefficient algorithm)
notes: delay-gfp pattern variant: mdelay() busy-waits the CPU; in a non-atomic caller (here PM resume), msleep() should be used instead. Detector should flag mdelay() calls reachable only from clearly sleepable contexts (functions like *_resume, *_suspend, *_probe, *_init, *_open, *_release without enclosing spinlock/IRQ/rcu_read_lock). The 'critical variable' slot is occupied by the delay argument (constant ms) — only the constant being 'large enough' to be wasteful matters (here 100 ms).
